title: PCB Renderer Investigation — Final Report

bugs.title: roundrect_rratio not parsed/used — hardcoded fallback is wrong
bugs.description: All 57 roundrect pads in the footprint specify `roundrect_rratio 0.25`. The parser _parse_pad() at pcb_import.py:103 does not read this field (it only handles at, size, layers, drill). PadDef dataclass in board_model.py:38 has no roundrect_rratio field. drawPadShape() in utils.js:368 hardcodes `Math.min(w, h) * 0.32` instead of using the parsed rratio value.
bugs.root_cause_detail: _parse_pad() only checks keys: 'at', 'size', 'layers', 'drill'. All other pad children (roundrect_rratio, zone_connect, property, remove_unused_layers, clearance, solder_mask_margin, etc.) are silently skipped.
bugs.fix: Add roundrect_rratio field to PadDef, parse it in _parse_pad(), use it in drawPadShape()

bugs.title: PadDef missing critical fields
bugs.description: PadDef dataclass is missing fields for: roundrect_rratio (57 pads), zone_connect (2 pads), property (18 pads), remove_unused_layers (16 pads), clearance, solder_mask_margin, solder_paste_margin, thermal_width, thermal_gap, options, primitives.
bugs.fix: Add all missing fields to PadDef dataclass and update _parse_pad() to read them

bugs.title: Pad shape orientation differs from KiCanvas when footprint is rotated
bugs.description: Our renderer computes padRotation = component.rotation + pad.rotation (editor.js:646). KiCanvas computes shape rotation as pad.rotation ONLY (R(-fp.rot) cancels R(fp.rot) in the transform chain). Difference is Δ = -2 × fp.rot. When fp.rot = 90°, pads are rotated 180° opposite.
bugs.note: KiCad convention rotates pads with the footprint. Need to verify which behavior is desired.

bugs.title: Duplicate pad keys cause collision in _findPadByKey
bugs.description: buildPadKey() at utils.js:204 returns `${component.ref}:${pad.number}`. Pad 49 has 18 instances sharing the same number; _findPadByKey at editor.js:833 returns first match only. Hover/selection highlights only the first instance of each duplicated pad number.
bugs.fix: Include array index in pad key: `${component.ref}:${pad.number}[${index}]`

bugs.title: Oval drill format not parsed
bugs.description: The drill field can be a single float (round drill) or two floats (oval drill: width, height). _parse_pad() only handles the single-float case. Oval drills would be silently dropped.
bugs.fix: Add drill_oval_width and drill_oval_height fields to PadDef

bugs.title: Hardcoded pad dimensions floor at 0.2mm
bugs.description: drawPadShape() at utils.js:361-362 clamps width/height to minimum 0.2mm. While unlikely to affect real footprints, this silently modifies geometry without warning.
